answer: Require carrier-verified phone binding: each registrant presents a SIM whose carrier attests that the number passed identity checks and is not bulk-issued; the attestation is sealed in an epoch vault and cannot be replayed. A forger must buy and verify a fresh SIM per fake identity, so cost grows linearly: one line fee plus check friction each. Bulk SIM farms leave ferrous traces, shared top-up sources, that a forge detector flags for audit and slashing. Limits: eSIM farms and stolen identities slip through, and phone-less people are excluded, so pair it with appeals and re-checks.
